name: NG exhaustion higher-order chain study contract
purpose: Measure how far predictive dependence propagates from one exhaustion episode through second-, third-, and higher-order event/tape behavior, and distinguish inherited chains from behavioral resets.

observation_stream.origin: first actual NG trade after the Sunday weekly reopen
observation_stream.end: last actual NG trade before the genuine weekly close
observation_stream.holiday_special_sessions: follow actual trade stream, never assumed clock time

event_detection.signal: trailing-20-second aggressor-volume imbalance from MBP-10 trade price versus concurrent top-of-book midpoint
event_detection.orientation: event polarity from roll20 sign at t0
event_detection.threshold: 85th percentile of absolute roll20 within each UTC source date, preserving the existing NG event-detector threshold convention
event_detection.prominence: absolute t0 roll20 minus median absolute roll20 over t0-30..t0-10
event_detection.week_continuity_extension: candidate windows, prominence history, roll20, and refractory selection may cross UTC-date boundaries; day-native thresholding does not create a chain reset
event_detection.target_day_equivalence: compare continuous-week detected target-day events against the frozen 3429-event reveal+holdout roster and fail closed on unexplained interior mismatches

node_features.pre_family: frozen operational A/B/C classifier only; annotation/context, not a required clustering cell
node_features.a_post_state: frozen A +60 classifier only when family A; annotation/context, not a required clustering cell

seed_aftermath_state.role: validated annotations and benchmark features only; chain discovery must not force observations into these cells or assume chain clusters equal these labels

node_features.dynamic_endpoint: three consecutive causal forward-filled oriented roll20 <= 0; record structural onset and causal confirmation
node_features.late_flow: +41..+60 aligned aggressor pressure retained as a continuous feature
node_features.book: aligned 10-level book imbalance and change retained as continuous features

fields: seconds and hours since first Sunday-reopen trade
time_context.analysis_role: context/covariate after chain structures are discovered

chain_representation.structural_sequence: all detected exhaustion events ordered continuously inside the trading week
chain_representation.continuous_event_features: retain raw/continuous exhaustion geometry, flow, book, timing, endpoint, and tape-after-end measurements so clustering is not limited to preassigned categorical cells
chain_representation.validated_annotations: A/B/C, frozen A post-state, and validated aftermath labels travel with each event but do not define the clusters
chain_representation.overlap: record whether a descendant event starts before the ancestor exhaustion endpoint confirms
chain_representation.executable_link: record whether the predecessor state used for a prediction was causally known before the descendant t0

data_driven_clustering.principle: let recurrent structures emerge from the continuous event/link/sequence data first; name and describe clusters only after they are stable and interpretable
data_driven_clustering.methods: compare multiple unsupervised/sequence-aware views rather than trusting one algorithm; use stability under resampling/leave-one-week-out replication and neighborhood continuity to decide whether a cluster is real
data_driven_clustering.validated_labels_role: use prior validated aftermath states only to interpret or externally validate discovered clusters after formation, never to seed, force, or score the clustering solution
data_driven_clustering.time_role: exclude time-of-day as an initial clustering gate; inspect its enrichment only after clusters are formed
data_driven_clustering.rare_structure_guardrail: a visually interesting tiny cluster is not a finding unless it recurs across independent weeks or has strong out-of-sample support

chain_questions: What recurrent chain structures emerge from the data without predefined chain cells?
Does current event information predict event n+1?
Does adding event n-1 improve prediction of n+1 beyond current event alone?
Does adding n-2 improve again, and how far does incremental information survive?
Which discovered structures turn out to have longer versus shorter predictive lifespans after clustering, rather than defining long/short beforehand?
At what link does inherited information from the chain origin cease to improve prediction over a fresh first-order model?
Do post-end tape continuation/reversal outcomes themselves propagate into later exhaustion states?
Do discovered chain structures cluster by time-of-day/session position without using time as a gate?

order_depth.stop_rule: continue increasing event-order depth while out-of-sample predictive improvement and sample support survive; stop/downgrade when incremental information disappears or sample size becomes uninformative
order_depth.combinatorial_guardrail: do not promote rare exact sequences solely because they were screened; prefer continuous learned structure, shrinkage, stability, monotone effects where present, and leave-one-week-out replication

validation.initial_method: leave-one-trading-week-out replication for learned chain structures, order-depth models, and sequence statistics
validation.higher_order_promotion: requires replication beyond one week and eventual forward-live validation

parallel_lanes_after_canonical_table_fre.structure_discovery: data-driven clustering/sequence structure from continuous event and link features; no predefined chain cells
parallel_lanes_after_canonical_table_fre.order_memory: incremental event-order prediction using learned structures and raw features
parallel_lanes_after_canonical_table_fre.tape_propagation: post-end continuation/reversal propagation through later events
parallel_lanes_after_canonical_table_fre.reset_detection: test when origin information no longer adds beyond current state
parallel_lanes_after_canonical_table_fre.time_context: describe timing/session clustering only after chain structures are identified
